reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin providing isolated /btw side questions that reuse the active session context, answer through a separate tool-free model request, and show results without adding them to the main conversation history.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 /btw 旁路提问，在复用当前会话上下文的同时独立生成一次回答，并通过临时面板展示而不写入主会话历史。
summaries.en: Adds /btw side questions to DeepSeek Harness by reusing the active session context for a separate tool-free model response shown in a temporary panel without entering the main conversation history.

capabilities: reads and snapshots context from the active parent session
sends a separate one-shot model request without tool execution
displays the response in a temporary interface panel
can persist sidechain records as private JSONL or keep them in memory
supports request cancellation and timeout handling
